eraseMember.reason: Only the initial trusted workspace identity selection is migrated. Off mode still calls the exact original WorkspaceMetadata accessor; bounded mode takes only the installed core Workspace.ID through eraseMemberWorkspaceID. The former-member read uses BeginFormerMembersRead and defers Close through every map use, retaining the original ignored-error and partial-map behavior. TestScaleP21SW25ErasureIdentityDifferential compares exact success inputs and refusal responses across the principal/key matrix, exact/default/missing/case/NUL keys, cross-workspace bindings and queued/replayed revocation without adding authorization to this trusted read; unrelated body bytes and full decode count stay unchanged. TestScaleP21SW25ErasureLegacySuccessAndRemainingWriter proves complete off-mode account erasure still succeeds and bounded erasure still refuses at the independently pending erasePersonInWorkspace writer. This is not a claim that the erasure endpoint is ready in bounded mode. The final targeted set passed twice on persistent SQLite.
